title: Bibi ordered Trump to attack Iran!!
text:
Bibi ordered Trump to attack Iran!!"

"Netanyahu reveals how he convinced Trump to bomb Iran:"

"'It wasn't: Do you allow us or not? It was: Here's what we're going to do. I'm informing you'"

"Says he brought seven slides into the Oval Office and pitched the US on using B-2 bombers to strike Iran's Fordow nuclear site
